response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but their profile does not match this role's core requirements. Professional C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a thesis project, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. There is no evidence of capital markets, investment banking, or fixed-income domain experience, and no SQL Server/Oracle depth. Strengths in TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and low-latency systems are largely orthogonal to this engagement.
strengths: Strong low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang, async I/O at Dunnhumby)
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, DevOps tooling
Broad polyglot background with some C/C++ exposure and Java/Python-adjacent skills
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ work, nearly a decade ago; no Windows C++ platform depth
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE is fintech-adjacent at best)
No demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle experience; database work centers on MongoDB/MySQL

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering fundamentals and performance-systems background
